3.3. Helmholtz Equation ∆w + λw = –Φ(x)
Many problems related to steady-state oscillations (mechanical, acoustical, thermal, electromag-
netic) lead to the two-dimensional Helmholtz equation. For λ < 0, this equation describes mass
transfer processes with volume chemical reactions of the first order.
    The two-dimensional Helmholtz equation has the following form:
